name: network-watch
description: Outbound destination monitoring via tshark: DNS/SNI/Host/SYN observations, destination aggregation, foreign-country marking from Wireshark's MaxMind lookup, and a Tela list file for the desktop overlay.
cardTemplate: Summarise the network-watch domain: tshark capture lifecycle, metadata-only observations, IP-to-domain mapping from captured DNS answers, foreign/domestic/unknown classification, read-only API, and the TELA_LIST_VIEW overlay file.
rationale: Network destination monitoring owns an external capture process and a country policy that change independently of process resource sampling (resource-monitoring) and public ingress protection (intrusion). Tests also belong to the cross-cutting test-environment domain.
